rulebook: PHASE 2 / PHASE 4. Each entry records what the GOVERNED Airtable price-basis prose actually states, on three independent axes. Nothing is inferred from supplier type, price level, catalogue depth, or the absence of an exclusion. The analytical class is DERIVED from the axes, never typed by hand. A supplier marketing word (turnkey, premium, luxury, all-in) is never evidence.
